newsitem.title: USA: ISS opposes bid by Dominion Bridge dissident group.
newsitem.headline: ISS opposes bid by Dominion Bridge dissident group.

text.p: Dominion Bridge Corp said Thursday that Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) has reaffirmed its earlier recommendation that Dominion shareholders should vote against the proposals made by the Kuhn committee, a dissident shareholder group.

ISS concluded that "supporting the committee's campaign at this time would not benefit shareholders, primarily due to the provisions contained in the committee's proposed bylaws," according to Dominion.
The dissident panel has initiated proxy solications of management.
"We believe that the committee's bylaws would make it almost impossible for the company's board to consider any offers independently," the company said ISS concluded.
Last week Dominion Bridge said it had accepted the recommendation of investment bankers Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc to either sell the company or pursue a strategic partner.
The company has formed an independent committee to review all the alternatives, it said.
ISS, based in Bethesda, Md., is an independent adviser on proxy contests and corporate governance issues for large shareholders.
